newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shinji Sato to become Japan's trade minister - NHK.
newsitem.headline: Shinji Sato to become Japan's trade minister - NHK.

text.p: Shinji Sato, a senior member of the Liberal Democratic Party, will be appointed the head of the powerful Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) in Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's new cabinet, NHK public television reported on Thursday.
Hashimoto is likely to form a new cabinet after his expected reappointment as prime minister on Thursday afternoon.
Sato, a son of former prime minister Eisaku Sato, had assumed the posts of transport minister and vice minister of trade in the past.

Hashimoto is expected to appoint Hiroshi Mitsuzuka, a former trade minister and leader of one of the inter-party factions in the LDP, as finance minister, Japanese media reported. Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda will retain his post in Hashimoto's new cabinet, it said.
Japan's House of Representatives will hold a special parliamentary session to select the prime minister from 1 p.m. (0400 GMT) on Thursday.
